title: Unit Event — Burn My Soul — Episode7 A Fire That Burns On

meta.Episode: Episode7 — A Fire That Burns On
meta.Event Outline: Vivid BAD SQUAD and Ken burn the candle at both ends figuring out how they'll surpass RAD WEEKEND. Tasked with reigniting fervor in the residents of Vivid Street, Akito tries to burn brighter than ever before, but will it go up in smoke?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
(He seems much calmer today...
I'm not sensing any of his usual anxiety today.)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: I take it you figured something out...?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
In that case, I'll start us off today.
Ready?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
(I see...
He's focusing on the way I'm singing.)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: (Then, I'll need to put on a good performance for him...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Hearing Ken sing just fills me up with so much excitement. I can feel the pulse in my fingers.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(On top of that, lately...
He's been singing just for me.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (This has to be some kind of miracle...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Feel his song. Let it flow through you...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Listen to the man who ignited an eternal flame in you.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (You got the blood pumping in my heart. You. No one else.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (It's because of you that I'm stood here right now.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Nervousness, excitement, happiness... All these emotions I should have felt being around you. I should never have suppressed them like I did.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Which is why I'm going to feel them all now, completely. Everything you gave me.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I'm gonna turn that into my strength and surpass you!!)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: (You have a habit of overthinking things. That's why you need to make things more simple for yourself.)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: (Happiness, sadness, anger... Everything you've felt... That all needs to become your fuel.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (He sang like this at RAD WEEKEND...!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(No...
What am I doing...? I thought I was ready for this.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Am I really going to be able to...?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Burn everything that you have inside of you!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (You gave me so much when I saw you at RAD WEEKEND.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Things were really hard at first, and I felt like giving up more times than I wanna admit.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (They decided to stand by my side.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(And...
Even after gaining and losing so much...
Even after being beaten to a pulp like this, I can keep going...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Because I'm never going to forget that night!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (The flame you lit inside of me that night is still burning strong.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (And I can't thank you enough for that.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(That's right...
Take everything away, and this is what's left.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (That desire. The one that brought me this far.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(I'm gonna surpass you.
I'm gonna surpass RAD WEEKEND, and then I'll go even further!!!)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: I want to witness the moment you and your team surpass us.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Alright, you've all put in plenty of effort until today.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
You've all reached a good level.
I say the time is ripe.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
It's time for you to lead the charge.
Are you ready?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yes.
I'm ready to go whenever.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You know, a part of me still wants us all to sing together since this is our big return...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I know you're gonna really ignite everyone, Akito!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Me too...!
I know you can do it, Shinonome!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Your hard work will pay off...
I firmly believe that.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Give it everything you've got.
We'll be watching from across the street so that we don't get in your way.
